dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the members of the FDIC Board of Directors, prospective nominees, and banking regulatory agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Board of Directors of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation

dimensions.assessment: Alters voting structure on the FDIC board and establishes professional background criteria and term limits for appointed members.
dimensions.evidence: removes the director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau from the board as a voting member and instead makes them a non-voting observer

dimensions.assessment: Negligible fiscal impact as it concerns board governance rather than federal spending or taxation.
Amends the Federal Deposit Insurance Act regarding board membership, voting rights, and service duration limits.
dimensions.evidence: Section 2 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (12 U.S.C. 1812) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Imposes permanent structural changes to FDIC board governance, term limits, and eligibility criteria.
dimensions.evidence: No individual may be appointed as a member for more than two terms.

missing_information: Exact number of future board appointees affected by the term limits.
importance_detail.rationale: Revises the composition and membership requirements of the FDIC Board of Directors by changing the CFPB Director to a non-voting observer, adding specific professional experience requirements, and limiting board member terms.
